evidence.headline:
Finetuning LLMs on small datasets makes them forget.

Ambient SFT solves this by treating the model pre-finetuning as a "noisy teacher", that we can only trust at a coarse level.
evidence.idea:
As we finetune, we regularize the model to match its predictions pre-finetuning at a “coarse level”.

This keeps existing capabilities while letting the model learn new ones.
bullets: For example, fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B on ~20K instruction-following examples raises IFEval by 21 points, but costs up to 10 points on knowledge, math, and coding benchmarks.

Ambient SFT learns the task just as well (+20 on IFEval) while mostly keeping what the model knew. 

It even gains new capabilities: +7 on MATH and +20 on GSM8K.
We show gains in all three post-training regimes: up to 26.7 % 26.7\% lower perplexity than the best baseline across five domain-adaptation targets;
evidence.summary: Introducing Ambient SFT: a drop-in replacement for SFT for llms.
evidence.practice_takeaway: This keeps existing capabilities while letting the model learn new ones.

self_report_as_fact.why: Authors' claim that Ambient SFT solves or prevents forgetting is stated as fact, with no credit in headline or idea.

result.why: Authors' own claim written as fact.
